correctness.rationale: A binary point lies between the endpoints in graph distance exactly if it agrees with them on every coordinate where they agree; on the other coordinates either bit incurs one step in total. The independent replay uses this coordinate predicate and grows sorted faces by admissible single-vertex extension, rather than running the uploaded script. It finds 400 forbidden triples and nonempty levels of sizes (16,120,160,120,16) followed by an empty level. Using the stated pivot order on the resulting tuple faces, pair all eligible cells at each pivot: no conflict is possible within a pivot because the upper partner uniquely determines the lower one by deletion. The replay finds 191 pairs and unpaired cell counts (1,40,0,9,0) by dimension. It orients every one of the 1,280 nonempty-face codimension-one incidences according to the matching and uses depth-first cycle detection; all 432 faces are visited with no directed cycle. Forman's theorem therefore produces a CW model with one zero-cell, forty one-cells, no two-cells, nine three-cells, and no higher cells. Each three-cell attaches to the graph by a map from S². The universal cover of the graph is a tree, so every such map is nullhomotopic. Consequently the CW model is a wedge of forty circles and nine three-spheres, not just a match of Betti numbers. This is a complete finite certificate for the specified cube.
residual_risks: The specified matching and complete enumeration concern only Q4; they do not certify a result for larger cubes.

value.rationale: This is a canonical binary cube and the simplicial complex of every graph-geodesic general-position configuration, not an arbitrary subset of cases. The exact topology gives a free fundamental group of rank forty and nine 3-sphere summands, information absent from the known extremal size. The explicit acyclic certificate gives future computations a reproducible small-cube benchmark with higher cells and an actual homotopy identification rather than only an Euler characteristic.
residual_risks: No assertion that this is the first cube with a particular feature, or that the method gives a formula for arbitrary cube dimension.
